name: FotoJet
description_en:
FotoJet is PearlMountain’s browser suite for graphic design, collages and photo editing. Users work with layouts/templates or image adjustments and decorations; basic creation is available without registration, while FotoJet Plus unlocks advanced tools, custom size, project save/load, cloud storage and premium resources.

It fits quick photo treatments, collages, cards and promotional layouts, subject to asset/use permissions. The header’s AI image tools lead to FlexClip and an AI video link leads elsewhere; these links are not proof those services are included with FotoJet Plus. Paid tool access must also be distinguished from the terms’ restrictive shared-content license.
description_zh:
FotoJet是PearlMountain的浏览器图形设计、拼图及照片编辑套件，使用布局/模板或图片调整和装饰；基础创作无需注册，Plus解锁高级工具、自定义尺寸、项目保存/加载、云存储及高级资源。

它适合快速照片处理、拼图、卡片和宣传布局，但需确认素材/用途权限。页头AI图像工具指向FlexClip，AI视频又指向其他服务，不证明包含在FotoJet Plus中。付费工具访问也需区别于条款对共享内容的限制许可。

sections.title_en: Use the right creation mode and keep linked products separate
sections.title_zh: 选对创作模式并区分外链产品
sections.en:
The [homepage](https://www.fotojet.com/) provides Create a Design, Make a Collage and Edit a Photo. Photo Editor includes crop/resize/rotate, exposure/color enhancement, sharpening/dehaze, text, clipart, frames, overlays, color splash and tilt-shift effects. Collage and design modes arrange several assets rather than simply altering one photo. Basic use is advertised without installation or registration.

The AI header is not an integrated entitlement list: actual links for text-to-image, background removal, restoration and similar tools point to flexclip.com, while the AI video agent points to another domain. Do not assign those models, credits or video capabilities to FotoJet Plus merely because they share navigation. The record retains FotoJet’s own task boundary.
sections.zh:
[首页](https://www.fotojet.com/)提供Create a Design、Make a Collage及Edit a Photo。照片编辑含裁切/改尺寸/旋转、曝光/色彩增强、锐化/去雾、文字、剪贴画、边框、叠层、局部彩色及移轴效果；拼图/设计用于多素材布局，不只是改单图。基础使用宣传无需安装或注册。

AI页头不是整合权益表：文生图、去背景、修复等实际链接指向flexclip.com，AI视频代理指向另一域名。不能仅因共用导航就把其模型、点数或视频能力归入Plus，本文保留FotoJet自身任务范围。

sections.title_en: Prepare a photo or layout and preserve the editable project
sections.title_zh: 准备图片/布局并保留可编辑项目
sections.en:
A documentation-based workflow starts with the appropriate mode, loads a photo or template, adjusts crop/size/color, then adds only the text, frames or clipart needed for the deliverable. The [editor page](https://www.fotojet.com/features/photo-editor/) describes Auto Enhance, selective color splash and effects; it does not establish that every advanced option is free. Check the intended dimensions, readable text and output quality on a representative image.

If later revision matters, distinguish a flattened delivery image from a saved project. Plus explicitly lists save/load projects and cloud storage, so no equivalent free-project persistence is assumed. Retain source photos and permitted exports locally; the cloud-storage marketing does not establish backup recovery, retention or a portable interchange format. No editing session or output was executed.
sections.zh:
基于文档的流程是选合适模式，载入照片或模板，调整裁切/尺寸/颜色，再添加交付所需文字、边框或剪贴画。[编辑页](https://www.fotojet.com/features/photo-editor/)介绍Auto Enhance、局部彩色及效果，不证明每个高级项免费。应以代表图片检查尺寸、文字可读性和输出质量。

如需后续修改，应区分扁平交付图与保存的项目。Plus明确列保存/加载和云存储，不推定免费同样持久化。应本地保留原图及允许的输出，云存储宣传不建立备份恢复、保留期限或可移植交换格式。本文未运行编辑或输出。

sections.title_en: Monthly versus annual Plus and the seven-day trial
sections.en:
The [billing FAQ](https://www.fotojet.com/pricing.html) explicitly lists $6.99 USD/month or $39.99 USD/year, shown as roughly $3.33/month billed annually. Annual billing is the full year charge, not a $3.33 monthly contract. Plus lists advanced tools, 600+ premium templates, 500+ premium resources, priority support and an ad-free experience. These counts are vendor catalog descriptions, not a check that every shown asset is available for every use.

The page promotes a seven-day Plus trial whose payment copy says automatic charging afterward unless canceled. Trial/free creation and recurring Plus are different. Exact current checkout/eligibility, taxes and renewal rate were not tested. A card-only FAQ coexists with PayPal checkout/payment-failure wording, so the accepted payment methods should be confirmed in the actual current flow rather than inferred from every hidden payment fragment.
sections.zh:
[收费FAQ](https://www.fotojet.com/pricing.html)明确列美元每月$6.99或每年$39.99，年付折合约每月$3.33，后者是整年账单，不是每月$3.33可取消合同。Plus列高级工具、600+高级模板、500+高级资源、优先支持及无广告。这些是厂商目录描述，不证明每个素材适用每种用途。

页面宣传七天Plus试用，付款文字写明未取消后自动扣款。试用/免费创作与循环Plus不同，实际当前结账/资格、税费及续费价未测。只接受信用卡的FAQ又与PayPal结账/失败提示并存，支付方式应以真实当前流程核实，不从所有隐藏片段推定。

sections.title_en: Cancellation and switching are different operations
sections.title_zh: 取消及换套餐是不同操作
sections.en:
The FAQ says recurring subscriptions renew until canceled. My Account → Cancel My Subscription stops future billing while access continues to the current period’s end. Direct plan changes are not supported: cancel and subscribe to the other plan; changing payment method likewise requires canceling and resubscribing after the current term. The exact transition date and whether a new trial applies were not independently tested.

The page states charges are nonrefundable. Failure examples include expired cards, rejected/delayed bank payments and PayPal balance/account issues; those are troubleshooting possibilities, not a diagnosis of a particular user payment. Verify account/receipt status before retrying to avoid unintended duplicate subscriptions. No payment, cancellation or resubscription was performed.
sections.zh:
FAQ表示订阅取消前持续续费。My Account → Cancel My Subscription停止未来账单，当前账期末前仍可用。不支持直接换套餐，需取消后订另一档；换支付方式同样要取消，当前期结束再订。准确转换日期及能否再试用未独立测试。

页面写明费用不退，付款失败示例包括卡到期、银行拒绝/延迟及PayPal余额/账户问题；这些只是排障可能，不是对具体付款的诊断。重试前应核查账户/收据状态，避免意外重复订阅。本文未付款、取消或重新订阅。

sections.title_en: Premium access does not establish unrestricted commercial asset rights
sections.title_zh: 高级访问不证明素材商业用途无限制
sections.en:
The [June 28,2020 terms](https://www.fotojet.com/terms.html) retain PearlMountain/licensor IP and grant a limited revocable service/content license. The Limited License text describes personal/noncommercial access to shared content and imposes conditions for incorporating provider content into substantially changed work, including acknowledgment. This is narrower than simply assuming all templates can be resold or used as exclusive branding. Current commercial scope for a particular client/asset should be clarified in writing.

Users must have rights to their own uploads and remain responsible for third-party claims; the terms do not promise every contributed asset is non-infringing. The hosted service is proprietary, and a free tier is not an open-source grant. Privacy/retention, exact export formats, font licensing and cloud recovery were not fully established. No image or client material was uploaded and no commercial clearance or project save/load test was performed.
sections.zh:
[2020年6月28日条款](https://www.fotojet.com/terms.html)保留PearlMountain/许可人知识产权，并给有限可撤销服务/内容许可。Limited License将共享内容访问写为个人/非商业，使用提供方内容制作有实质修改的作品还附确认署名等条件。这比“全部模板可再售或作独占品牌”窄，具体客户/素材的当前商用范围应书面明确。

上传者须有权使用内容并负责第三方主张，条款不保证全部贡献素材不侵权。托管服务为专有，免费不等于开源。隐私/保留、准确导出格式、字体许可及云恢复未完整建立。未上传图片/客户材料，未做商业清权或项目保存/加载测试。
